defs.def: the fact of sb dying or being killed 死；死亡

ex.s: But in comparing a study of California forests done in the 1920s and 1930s with another one between 2001 and 2010, Mclntyre and his colleagues documented a widespread death of big trees that was evident even in wildlands protected from woodcutting or development.
ex.t: 但将20世纪20、30年代对加州森林的研究与2001至2010年的另一项研究对比后，麦金太尔及其同事记录了一种大树广泛死亡的现象，即使在免受砍伐或开发的荒野中也十分明显。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 17岁时，我读到一篇关于名为麦克奈的博物馆的文章，它曾是水彩画家玛丽安·麦克奈的故居。她曾要求社区在她去世后将其改建为博物馆。一个晴朗的周六，萨莉和我开车过去。她问：“你有地址吗？”“没有，但我能认出来，杂志上有张照片。”

ex.s: Only five years after Steve Jobs’ death, smart-phones defeated __________ PCs in sales.
ex.t: 史蒂夫·乔布斯去世仅五年后，智能手机销量就超过了个人电脑。

ex.s: Concerned with love, death and betrayal, Hamlet gives no easy answers to the questions it raises, and everyone understands it in a personal way.
